title: Cucurbitacin E reduces IL-1beta-induced inflammation and cartilage degeneration by inhibiting the PI3K/Akt pathway in osteoarthritic chondrocytes.
authors: Wang, Lin; Xu, Hui; Li, Xin; Chen, Hongwei; Zhang, Haigang; Zhu, Xunpeng; Lin, Zhijie; Guo, Shilei; Bao, Zhibo; Rui, Haicheng; He, Wei; Zhang, Hui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究葫芦素E通过抑制PI3K/Akt通路减轻骨关节炎软骨炎症与退变，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint disease. Cartilage degeneration is the earliest and most important pathological change in osteoarthritis, and persistent inflammation is one of the driving factors of cartilage degeneration. Cucurbitacin E, an isolated compound in the Cucurbitacin family, has been shown to have anti-inflammatory effects, but its role and mechanism in osteoarthritic chondrocytes are unclear. METHODS: For in vitro experiments, human chondrocytes were stimulated with IL-1beta, and the expression of inflammatory genes was measured by Western blotting and qPCR. The expression of extracellular matrix proteins was evaluated by immunofluorescence staining, Western blotting and saffron staining. Differences in gene expression between cartilage from osteoarthritis patients and normal cartilage were analysed by bioinformatics methods, and the relationship between Cucurbitacin E and its target was analysed by a cellular thermal shift assay, molecular docking analysis and molecular dynamics simulation. For in vivo experiments, knee osteoarthritis was induced by DMM in C57BL/6 mouse knee joints, and the effect of Cucurbitacin E on knee joint degeneration was evaluated. RESULTS: The in vitro experiments confirmed that Cucurbitacin E effectively inhibited the production of the inflammatory cytokine interleukin-1beta(IL-1beta) and cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) by IL-1beta-stimulated chondrocytes and alleviates extracellular matrix degradation. The in vivo experiments demonstrated that Cucurbitacin E had a protective effect on the knee cartilage of C57BL/6 mice with medial meniscal instability in the osteoarthritis model. Mechanistically, bioinformatic analysis of the GSE114007 and GSE117999 datasets showed that the PI3K/AKT pathway was highly activated in osteoarthritis. Immunohistochemical analysis of PI3K/Akt signalling pathway proteins in pathological slices of human cartilage showed that the level of p-PI3K in patients with osteoarthritis was higher than that in the normal group. PI3K/Akt were upregulated in IL-1beta-stimulated chondrocytes, and Cucurbitacin E intervention reversed this phenomenon. The cellular thermal shift assay, molecular docking analysis and molecular dynamics experiment showed that Cucurbitacin E had a strong binding affinity for the inhibitory target PI3K. SC79 activated Akt phosphorylation and reversed the effect of Cucurbitacin E on IL-1beta-induced chondrocyte degeneration, demonstrating that Cucurbitacin E inhibits IL-1beta-induced chondrocyte inflammation and degeneration by inhibiting the PI3K/AKT pathway. CONCLUSION: Cucurbitacin E inhibits the activation of the PI3K/AKT pathway, thereby alleviating the progression of OA. In summary, we believe that Cucurbitacin E is a potential drug for the treatment of OA.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨关节炎是一种退行性关节疾病。软骨退变是骨关节炎最早且最重要的病理变化，而持续炎症是软骨退变的驱动因素之一。葫芦素E（Cucurbitacin E）是葫芦素家族中的一种分离化合物，已被证明具有抗炎作用，但其在骨关节炎软骨细胞中的作用及机制尚不清楚。方法：在体外实验中，用人软骨细胞经IL-1β刺激，通过Western blotting和qPCR测量炎症基因的表达。通过免疫荧光染色、Western blotting和番红染色评估细胞外基质蛋白的表达。通过生物信息学方法分析骨关节炎患者软骨与正常软骨之间的基因表达差异，并通过细胞热位移分析、分子对接分析和分子动力学模拟分析葫芦素E与其靶标之间的关系。在体内实验中，通过DMM诱导C57BL/6小鼠膝关节骨关节炎，并评估葫芦素E对膝关节退变的影响。结果：体外实验证实，葫芦素E有效抑制了IL-1β刺激的软骨细胞产生炎症细胞因子白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）和环氧合酶-2（COX-2），并减轻了细胞外基质降解。体内实验表明，在骨关节炎模型中，葫芦素E对内侧半月板不稳定的C57BL/6小鼠膝关节软骨具有保护作用。机制上，对GSE114007和GSE117999数据集的生物信息学分析显示，PI3K/AKT通路在骨关节炎中高度激活。对人软骨病理切片中PI3K/Akt信号通路蛋白的免疫组化分析显示，骨关节炎患者的p-PI3K水平高于正常组。在IL-1β刺激的软骨细胞中，PI3K/Akt表达上调，而葫芦素E干预逆转了这一现象。细胞热位移分析、分子对接分析和分子动力学实验表明，葫芦素E对抑制靶标PI3K具有强结合亲和力。SC79激活Akt磷酸化并逆转了葫芦素E对IL-1β诱导的软骨细胞退变的作用，证明葫芦素E通过抑制PI3K/AKT通路来抑制IL-1β诱导的软骨细胞炎症和退变。结论：葫芦素E抑制PI3K/AKT通路的激活，从而缓解OA的进展。总之，我们认为葫芦素E是治疗OA的潜在药物。
